newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI to restructure foundry operation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI to restructure foundry operation.

text.p: Heavy engineering firm Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Monday it planned to restructure its ANI Bradken foundry operations which would involve extensive new investment in its Queensland operations, and the possible closure of two sites.
ANI said the restructuring followed a special analysis as part of the company's overall strategic review earlier this year.
It said the changes would have no immediate impact on operations or employment, with a final decision subject to a feasibility study to be completed by January or February 1997.
If the two plants were to be closed, Ipswich would be shut between June and September next year and the Salisbury plant in early 1998.
ANI said some employees would be relocated if the plants were shut.
